answer: An operator running 184 keys therefore pays for 184 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the opal quota and the dune admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the raven ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. Challenge issue is rate limited to 10 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
